Scoring_point_3_Problem_1.answer: Inflated number of attendees – false claim: The claim states 10 people attended the working lunch on 1 January 2025, with a receipt of €161.60. However, lab assignment records confirm three individuals were on duty in Lab 3B during the lunch period and could not have attended. Only 7 people were actually present. By falsely adding 3 attendees, the claimant violated the reimbursement policy and committed fraud.
